title: Which UK party leader will announce plans in early July 2026 to resign as an MP and contest the resulting by-election?
background: A parliamentary resignation can trigger a by-election, which the departing MP may contest to seek a fresh mandate.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Public announcements corroborated by contemporaneous reporting from BBC News, The Guardian, or Al Jazeera. 
  Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the UK political party leader who publicly announces, between July 1 and July 9, 2026, plans to resign from the House of Commons and stand in the by-election caused by that resignation. The announcement is sufficient; the by-election need not have taken place. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The party leader's full name.
